lanes.title: RTM-595 common-cause / Table-10
lanes.intent: Validate semantic identity, provenance and deterministic re-entry semantics for common-cause/Table-10 evidence without inventing source values.
lanes.stop_condition: Unknown or missing source semantics remain UNKNOWN/DEFERRED.

lanes.title: OFFER-49 HSE
lanes.intent: Validate OFFER/RTM/deliverable/HSE vocabulary, evidence classes and source lineage before child promotion.
lanes.stop_condition: Agenda presence, review presence or inferred mapping cannot become compliance evidence.

lanes.title: SAT / deemed acceptance
lanes.intent: Define and validate typed acceptance-chain semantics across requirement, test, result, return, minute and re-entry objects.
lanes.stop_condition: Deemed acceptance may only be represented when its contractual trigger and evidence are source-bound.

lanes.title: MINERVA P&ID semantic federation
lanes.intent: Reconcile semantic objects produced from the real SVG baseline with parser/model objects and classify differences as improvement, regression, different input set, deferred or unknown.
lanes.stop_condition: SVG XML remains source authority; no OCR/raster-derived object may silently override it.

guards: multi-label semantics do not create duplicate compliance atoms
parent semantic return cannot self-promote child state
